player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to take the "red beetle" without first searching the specific locations where ingredients are hidden (the ice box, the ingredient rack, or the cupboard). I also wasted turns trying to brew the potion while holding too many items, causing the inventory limit to block me from taking the cauldron. Next time, I will first scan the room descriptions for ingredient locations (e.g., "ice box", "ingredient rack") and attempt to open or interact with those containers immediately. Once I have collected the necessary ingredients (water, red beetle, spiderweb, sandwich), I will drop all non-essential items to free up inventory space, then take the cauldron and execute the recipe steps in order.
